name: New England High School Cross Country Championships
where: Belfast, ME · Troy Howard Middle School
headline: New England High School Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Bishop Hendricken won the boys title by 93 points, 53 to Coe-Brown Northwood’s 146, as Colby Flynn won in 15:03.74 and teammate Shepherd Butler placed fourth. Cumberland edged Exeter 128 to 129 for the girls team title, and Hopkinton’s Madeleine Lane won the girls race in 16:42.10, 9.7 seconds ahead of Exeter’s Alexis Paterna.
